  **Value:** -0.3 to 4.0 · **Unit:** `V`

  **Conditions:** VDD external supply voltage absolute maximum (Table 18); Table 19 note 1: all VDD/VDDA, VBAT and VSS/VSSA pins must always be connected to the external supplies, in the permitted range. I/O input voltage, injected current and operating VDD are separate facts. Read from the owner's text conversion of DS12992 Rev 4 (see the source's authority note), not from a PDF render.

<EvidenceFact>
  <EvidenceAnchor id="fact-stm32g031g8u6tr-abs-max-vin-ft" />

  **Fact:** `fact-stm32g031g8u6tr-abs-max-vin-ft`

  **Value:** -0.3 to VDD + 4.0 · **Unit:** `V`

  **Conditions:** input voltage on FT\_xx pins (Table 18); any other pin -0.3 to 4.0 V; above 4 V the internal pull-up/pull-down must be disabled; when an FT\_a pin is used by an analog peripheral such as the ADC the maximum is 4 V. Read from the owner's text conversion of DS12992 Rev 4 (see the source's authority note), not from a PDF render.

  **Verdict:** PASS - primary-source confirmed · **Provenance:** PRIMARY-SPEC

  **Evidence:** [src-stm32g031g8u6tr-ds-text-p45: Table 18 row VIN and notes 2-3](#src-stm32g031g8u6tr-ds-text-p45)
</EvidenceFact>

<EvidenceFact>
  <EvidenceAnchor id="fact-stm32g031g8u6tr-iinj-pin" />

  **Fact:** `fact-stm32g031g8u6tr-iinj-pin`

  **Value:** -5 · **Unit:** `mA`

  **Conditions:** injected current on a FT\_xx pin, negative injection (VIN \< VSS); positive injection is NA: not possible on these I/Os and does not occur below the maximum VIN (Table 19 notes 2-3); IINJ(PIN) must never be exceeded. Separately, FT\_e pins with the switchable diode to VDDIO1 enabled in software accept up to 5 mA positive injection (Table 52, printed page 72; not read into a fact here); A5 uses FT\_e-capable pins such as PA3, PA5, PA6 and PA13. Read from the owner's text conversion of DS12992 Rev 4 (see the source's authority note), not from a PDF render.

  **Verdict:** PASS - primary-source confirmed · **Provenance:** PRIMARY-SPEC

</EvidenceFact>
